# Aloha Window Bros

> Family-run professional window cleaning service in Ventura County and Santa Barbara County, California. Two brothers from Thousand Oaks providing residential window, screen, frame, sill, and solar panel cleaning with a 100% satisfaction guarantee.

Aloha Window Bros is a locally owned, fully insured window cleaning company. We serve Thousand Oaks, Westlake Village, Agoura Hills, Newbury Park, Camarillo, Simi Valley, Oxnard, Ventura, Ojai, and Santa Barbara. Pricing for most residential homes ranges from $150 to $400 depending on size and window count. Free on-site estimates, usually within 24 hours. Phone: (805) 341-4121. Email: alohawindowbros@gmail.com.

## Service Areas
- [Thousand Oaks](https://alohawindowbros.com/thousand-oaks/): Home base — Conejo Valley, Westlake High alumni
- [Westlake Village](https://alohawindowbros.com/westlake/): Lake-adjacent and hillside properties
- [Agoura Hills](https://alohawindowbros.com/agoura/): Hillside and gated communities
- [Newbury Park](https://alohawindowbros.com/newbury/): Canyon-adjacent and Dos Vientos Ranch
- [Camarillo](https://alohawindowbros.com/camarillo/): Mission Oaks, Las Posas Estates, ag-belt
- [Simi Valley](https://alohawindowbros.com/simi-valley/): Wood Ranch, Big Sky, canyon corridor
- [Ventura](https://alohawindowbros.com/ventura/): Pierpont, Ventura Keys, hillsides
- [Oxnard](https://alohawindowbros.com/oxnard/): Beach + canal communities (Hollywood Beach, Mandalay Bay)
- [Ojai](https://alohawindowbros.com/ojai/): East End estates, Upper Ojai, Arbolada
- [Santa Barbara](https://alohawindowbros.com/santa-barbara/): Coastal + estate (Montecito, Hope Ranch, Mesa)

## Services
- [Window Washing](https://alohawindowbros.com/services/window-washing/): Exterior + interior glass, frames, sills with purified water and squeegee technique
- [Screen Cleaning](https://alohawindowbros.com/services/screen-cleaning/): Pressurized wash that removes dust, pollen, and grime
- [Solar Panel Cleaning](https://alohawindowbros.com/services/solar-panel-cleaning/): Restores energy output with purified-water rinse
